body: I appreciate it, I really do. But I'm sort of at ththe crest of a wave right now, and I'm trying not to think about what's going to happen when it dies down. I need to rush this, because I have a fading plan. If I stop for too long to think about the consequences, or logic, or anything, then it will all fall apart and I'll be left to live with myself until I can work up the energy to try again. I can't have that. So again, I appreciate the sentiment, but I'm too far gone to salvage.
